unit-test-coverage-helper-120220 v0.1.0

- Initial release.
- Provides a guided workflow to help users add unit tests and improve test coverage in existing codebases.
- Supports maintainers, QA engineers, open-source contributors, and product teams with practical steps, checklists, and validation advice.
- Delivers actionable artifacts and next-step suggestions tailored to user requirements.
- Activated by keywords related to unit testing, test coverage, and software quality.
